description: This file is a PHP web page for configuring MoCA (Multimedia over Coax Alliance) network settings on a gateway device. It includes server-side PHP code for initializing configuration parameters and client-side JavaScript for UI interactions and Ajax-based configuration updates. The page provides options to enable/disable MoCA, select channels, set privacy, and manage taboo frequencies.

methods.name: next_step
methods.description: Gathers current form values, constructs a JSON configuration string, and sends it via Ajax POST to apply the MoCA configuration.
